thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary deploy r-20260317-44 - runtime service canary showing p50/p95 regression on small-seq requests. Kernel-fallback flagged on 4/12 canary hosts. Auto-throttle engaged. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/runtime-canary-fallback

maria: paging oncall — I'm taking this. Observed customer errors + increased latency.

raj: raj (eng-runtime) here, joining. Any live customer reports?

sophia: Support reports two paying customers with timeouts/errors on /v1/complete around 10:10-10:14 UTC. CS opened tickets.

ana: (sre) I'm looking at host logs and kernel-selector metrics. Seeing rapid kernel fallback spikes and concurrent batch size collapse on affected canaries. Pasting a quick log snippet:

```
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z host-7 kernel-selector: score_v2=0.12 score_v1=0.98 -> fallback to legacy-kernel
2026-03-17T10:12:04Z host-7 batcher: target_batch=1 actual_batch=1 (expected 8)
2026-03-17T10:12:05Z host-7 eviction: kv_cache_miss=0.78
```

raj: looks like kernel-selector-v2 is misclassifying short sequences when KV warmup is low. Plan: flip the kill-switch for kernel-selector-v2 on canary slice immediately and start rolling back release r-20260317-44 from canary.

maria: how do we flip the flag? command?

raj: run: `fleetctl set-flag runtime kernel-selector-v2 off --scope canary --reason "canary fallback spike"` — I'll run it now.

incident-bot: kill-switch executed by raj at 2026-03-17T10:16:12Z. Flag kernel-selector-v2 -> OFF for scope: canary.

maria: early telemetry: p50 on affected canaries falling back toward baseline on 7/12 hosts within 1 minute. Error rate trending down from 6% -> 1.2%.

ana: additional note: batching pathology observed — median batch size dropped from 6 -> 1 on fallback hosts which reduced throughput and increased per-request overhead. Queue depth shows small spikes during fallback window.

raj: initiating canary rollback for r-20260317-44 across canary slice to fully remove runtime patch. Rolling traffic off canary nodes and draining sessions. Estimated 10min to complete.

leo: product/CS question: estimated customer impact window? Sophia, can you confirm which customers were affected?

sophia: Affected: AcmeChat and BrightDocs (both on hosted). CS notified them, offering post-incident call. We're tracking SLA exposure.

maria: mitigation snapshot: kill-switch + canary rollback -> p50 back to baseline on 9/12 hosts; overall platform errors back to normal range. Continuing to observe for 30m.

raj: monitoring: kernel-fallback counters dropping to zero, batch sizes returning to normal. I'll open a revert PR to remove the runtime change and a follow-up to adjust kernel scoring tests.

ana: for postmortem agenda: list suspected root cause — kernel-selector-v2 scoring edge-case with low KV cache hit-rate leading to fallback that interacts poorly with batching heuristics. Also add test coverage and gate for short-sequence workloads.

maria: handoff plan: if stable for 30m we'll close page. Night oncall notified: @raj will continue watch for next 60m, @ana to collect logs/metrics and @sophia to coordinate customer comms.

raj: ACK — monitoring 60m, will escalate if any regression.

incident-bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED by rollback and flag flip at 2026-03-17T10:26:40Z. Postmortem owner: raj.

maria: thanks team. Opening page to customers and scheduling a 1hr postmortem tomorrow to capture fixes and rollout gating. :thumbsup:
